records.text: A Turning Point USA source had documents proving Brian Harpole and Erika Kirk were not at Fort Huachuca and said they were intentionally giving Candace Owens rope to hang herself while building a defamation lawsuit.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #5 (Ep k1b1NDCrNFs)

appearances.snippet: And so the person saying, dude, he didn't see Erika (Erika Kirk) and Brian Harpole. He's just a con artist. My my source at Turning Point USA literally said they have all the documents and proof proof both Brian (Brian Harpole) and Erika (Erika Kirk) weren't there and they're purposefully giving Candace rope to hang herself.

verification.notes: The statement relies on an unnamed TPUSA source said to possess unspecified documents proving two people's locations and an intent to induce litigation. No named witness, published documents, or independently authenticated location records were available.

sources.title: Harpole v. Owens et al, No. 3:2026cv00556 (M.D. Tenn.)
sources.relevance: Confirms that litigation was filed, but not the anonymous source's documents, location claim, or alleged strategy.

conveyance.original_source: private Turning Point USA source message relayed by an unnamed military YouTuber
